question: Will Arda Güler have ≥3 total shots (on/off target) vs Valencia CF on Nov 7, 2026 (reg. + stoppage time only)?

model.prompt_context:

- "No, fewer than 3 shots": Wins if Arda Güler records 2 or fewer total shots (both on-target and off-target combined) under the same conditions and time window, or if Arda Güler does not appear in the match (did not play any minutes in regulation or stoppage time).

Clarifications:
- Total shots is defined as all shot attempts attributed to Arda Güler during regulation and stoppage time only — blocked shots, shots on target, and shots off target all count; penalty shootout attempts do not. If Arda Güler does not feature in the match, his shot total is 0, which resolves "No, fewer than 3 shots".
